[EVENT] User is trying to plan out their day and set reminders for their morning routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant cannot set alarms or reminders on the user's device but can guide them through the process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for setting a daily alarm for 7:30 am on weekdays for Android devices: Open the Clock app, tap the "+" icon, set the alarm time, tap "Repeat" and select "Monday" to "Friday," choose a ringtone and label, then tap "Save."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for setting a daily alarm for 7:30 am on weekdays for iOS devices: Open the Clock app, tap the "+" icon, set the alarm time, tap "Repeat" and select "Monday" to "Friday," choose a sound and label, then tap "Save."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for setting a daily alarm for other devices: Follow similar steps or use a third-party alarm clock app or virtual assistant.
